reveal_en: Plants don't just feel touch; some can detect specific vibrations in the air, like the sound of a caterpillar chewing on a nearby leaf. Upon "hearing" this, they can ramp up their chemical defenses.
reveal_zh: 植物不仅能感知触碰，有些还能探测空气中特定的振动，比如毛虫啃食附近叶子的声音。听到后，它们会增强化学防御。
meaning_en: This reveals a hidden layer of sensory perception in the natural world, suggesting plants are far more responsive than previously imagined.
meaning_zh: 这揭示了自然界中一个隐藏的感官层面，表明植物的反应能力远超我们想象。

visual.motion: Subtle vibrations ripple across a leaf, then small defensive spikes emerge.
